text:
### Validation Checks  
**UK Address Validation:**
- [ ] Postcode format correct (AA9A 9AA)
- [ ] Postcode matches city/town (use Royal Mail lookup)
- [ ] Address not on blacklist (fraudulent addresses)
- [ ] Property number/name is valid  
**International Address Validation:**
- [ ] Country is real and recognized
- [ ] Postal code format correct for country
- [ ] Address not in sanctions country (see Step 5: AML)
- [ ] Address format matches country requirements  
**Escalation If Validation Fails:**
- Don't accept invalid address
- Ask customer to re-confirm
- Provide postal code lookup tool
- Escalate if customer insists on non-standard address

raw_entities.name: Address Validation Process
raw_entities.description: A mandatory validation procedure for customer addresses that includes UK and international address format checks, blacklist screening, and sanctions country verification. The process includes escalation pathways when validation fails or customers provide non-standard addresses.

raw_entities.name: UK Address Format Validation
raw_entities.description: Verification step that checks UK postcode format compliance (AA9A 9AA pattern), matches postcode against city/town using Royal Mail lookup, validates property number/name, and screens address against fraudulent address blacklist.
context: Postcode matches city/town (use Royal Mail lookup)

raw_entities.name: International Address Format Validation
raw_entities.description: Verification step for non-UK addresses that validates country recognition, checks postal code format compliance for the specific country, verifies address is not in a sanctions country, and confirms address format matches country requirements.
context: Postal code format correct for country
Address not in sanctions country (see Step 5: AML)

raw_entities.name: Address Validation Failure Escalation
raw_entities.description: Escalation procedure triggered when address validation fails, requiring staff to reject invalid addresses, request customer re-confirmation, offer postal code lookup tool assistance, and escalate cases where customers insist on non-standard addresses.
context: Escalate if customer insists on non-standard address

raw_entities.name: Address Validation Pass/Fail Gate
raw_entities.description: A branching decision point that determines whether a customer-provided address passes all validation checks. Failed validation triggers escalation and customer re-confirmation procedures.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Country Address Screening
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance gate that verifies international addresses are not located in sanctions countries as part of AML screening obligations. This checkpoint must be passed before address acceptance.
context: Address not in sanctions country (see Step 5: AML)

raw_entities.name: Customer Address Verification
raw_entities.description: The address verification and validation process applied to customer-provided addresses, encompassing UK postcode validation, international format checks, blacklist screening, and sanctions country verification.

raw_entities.name: Address Validation Staff
raw_entities.description: Operations staff responsible for executing address validation checks, rejecting invalid addresses, requesting customer re-confirmation, and escalating cases where customers insist on non-standard addresses.
context: Escalate if customer insists on non-standard address

raw_entities.name: Address Validation Escalation Approver
raw_entities.description: Senior staff member responsible for reviewing and approving escalated address validation cases where customers insist on non-standard addresses or validation failures require management decision.
context: Escalate if customer insists on non-standard address
